tools.name: get_demo_request_status
tools.description: Check whether the person has confirmed a demo request (pending_confirmation, confirmed, expired, rejected_spam). Returns no personal data.

tools.name: get_dojomanager_info
tools.description: Short description of DojoManager, the offer (personal demo plus 6 months of the full version free, no commitment), supported disciplines, app languages and links to the Features, Pricing, Contact and demo pages in the requested language.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: request_demo · Private data: request_demo, get_dojomanager_info · Public sink: request_demo.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: request_demo · Private data: request_demo, get_dojomanager_info · Public sink: request_demo

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
